summary: Full regression of Go Perks. Ran 47 pytest cases across auth, public deals, member voucher/favorites, pending/approved business workflow, admin stats/monthly/top-deals/users/deals, admin decision email-link flow (approve + 409 reuse + 400 invalid + 410 expired), cron 401/accepted on all three endpoints, Stripe membership checkout session. All 47 passed. Playwright smoke: landing (1440px), /deals list (cards + filters visible), /admin control room (stats cards, 6-month revenue chart, top-deals present), /admin/decide?token=invalid (friendly 'This link isn\'t valid.' message), mobile 390px for deals + admin — all render without breaking errors.
